en.app.title: Portrait Studio · Prompt Library
en.settings.title: Settings
en.prompt.label: Prompts
en.header.title: Image inspirations
en.header.description: Every image includes a complete prompt ready to reuse.
en.sidebar.subtitle: PROMPT LIBRARY
en.sidebar.title: Image library
en.sidebar.quickCopyHint: Hover over an image and click the copy icon.
en.sidebar.locationHint: Images and complete bilingual prompts are stored below. Your selected library is remembered.

en.common.desktopOnly: Use the Mac desktop app for this action.

en.app.desktopRequired: Use the Mac desktop app to connect a local library and read its images and complete prompts.
en.app.noLibrary: No library folder is connected. Choose a writable local folder to import images and prompt JSON.
en.app.readonly: This library has no write permission. You can browse and copy; choose a writable folder to manage it.
en.gallery.hoverCopy: Hover over an image to copy its prompt
en.gallery.chooseFolderHint: Connect a writable local folder, then use Batch Import on the left to choose an image folder and a JSON file with full prompts.
en.gallery.emptyHint: Use Batch Import on the left to choose an image folder and a JSON file with full prompts, or import images one at a time.
en.gallery.noResultsHint: Try another name, number, or filename.
en.detail.intro: The complete generation prompt for this image
en.detail.shortcuts: Shortcuts: ⌘ Enter to copy · Esc to close · ← → to browse

en.editor.importHint: Choose a local image, enter its full English and Chinese prompts, then save it to the library folder shown on the left.
en.editor.imageHint: Choose a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image (up to 30 MiB). Enter the prompts on the right. A copy is saved; the original stays in place.
en.editor.name: Name
en.editor.promptEnPlaceholder: Paste the full English prompt, including all details and constraints.
en.editor.promptZhPlaceholder: Enter the corresponding full Chinese prompt.
en.editor.conflictHint: Your input has been kept. Review the latest library record before saving.
en.editor.removed: This image was removed. Cancel editing.
en.editor.currentCount: The library has {count} images. Check that this number is unused.
en.delete.title: Move to the system Trash?
en.delete.description: This image will be removed from the library and moved to the macOS Trash. Its English and Chinese prompts and recovery record stay in the local library folder. You can recover the image from the Trash.
en.batch.title: Batch import images and prompts
en.batch.hint: Choose a local image folder and a JSON file with full prompts. Preview the matches before confirming. Safe items are copied to your current library; source files stay in place.
en.batch.destination: Import to the current library folder
en.batch.unsupported: Batch import requires a Mac desktop app that supports this feature.
en.batch.imagesHint: Choose the local folder containing the images to import.
en.batch.manifestHint: Each image needs a number, name, image filename, and full English and Chinese prompts. Missing prompts are not generated or translated.
en.batch.invalidSelection: The selection is no longer authorized. Choose it again.
en.batch.invalidPreview: The preview is incomplete. Preview the selections again.
en.batch.conflictError: {reason} Preview again. Your image folder and JSON selections have been kept.
en.batch.missingReport: A complete import report was not returned. Refresh the library to check the actual result.
en.batch.cleanupError: The import was saved, but selections could not be cleared: {reason} Closing will retry the cleanup.
en.batch.column.name: Number / name
en.batch.reason.import: Matched successfully. Confirm to save a copy.
en.batch.reason.imported: The image and full prompts were saved to the current library.
en.batch.reason.skip: This image and its prompts already exist. The existing record is kept.
en.batch.reason.conflict: The number or content conflicts with an existing record. It will not be overwritten.
en.batch.reason.invalid: The record is incomplete or its image is invalid. It will not be imported.
en.batch.reason.unmatched: No unique image and prompt match was found. It will not be imported.
en.batch.reason.review: Review this record, then preview again.
en.batch.confirmHint: Confirm to import only {count} safe items. Duplicate, conflicting, and invalid items are skipped. Source files are kept.
en.batch.nothingImportable: No items can be safely imported. Review the issues, then choose new sources or edit the JSON. The current library has not changed.
en.batch.reportDetails: View item matches and import report
